name: JCR Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd.
summary: JCR Pharmaceuticals Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacture, import and export, and sale of pharmaceutical products, biopharmaceuticals, medical equipment, regenerative medicines, and drug substances in Japan. The comany offers various therapeutic products, including GROWJECT used for the treatment of growth hormone deficiency and short stature; IZCARGO to treat Mucopolysaccharidosis type II; Agalsidase Beta BS I.V. Infusion used for the treatment of Fabry disease; and TEMCELL HS Inj used to treat acute graft-versus-host disease.
